author: claude
incomplete_because: No fixed END-TO-END bound under lock contention: a busy callback's deadline is settled when the current lock holder releases; a run pass's hold time grows with its number of wake sends x the 30 s transport timeout, so detection <= 30 s holds only when holders release within about 25 s. Everything else in the allocation is delivered with evidence.

The timer cadence proof used the 844d156 binary as the checked command; cadence is the template's, the release carries the same template bytes (502745ac).
